title: Bot-team shared feed line
description: One JSON object per line in .estate/feed.jsonl. Every bot reads and writes the same feed; hand-offs happen here, not in private chats.

agent.description: Persona that wrote the line (KAR, BUILDER, MONEY TIME, REACH, SCOUT, CLIENT LEAD, CARD KEEPER, AUDITOR).

what.description: Plain-language action. Auto-redacted for keys/tokens/emails/card numbers before it reaches disk.

link.description: URL or path to the artifact/proof.

needs_owner.description: Next persona to act (hand-off), or 'Simon' when it needs his signature.

receipt_sha256.description: Hash of the re-runnable receipt. A 'done' claim with no receipt link is auto-flagged.

flags.description: Set by the feed writer, e.g. 'done-without-receipt'. Not written by the caller.
